sources.snippet: BLT Patch Size Rationale For C5, we set patch_size=9. Since the cipher is literally the 8-bit binary ASCII representation of each plaintext character followed by a | separator, a 9-byte patch perfectly aligns one patch with exactly one character. This is a sane inductive bias given the data's known periodicity, though the model still must learn the byte-to-character mapping and boundaries from ...
